assistant:
At **20:00 on 6 January 2000**, the measured operating point had two violations: **Bus_29 at 0.943 p.u.** (below 0.950) and **line Bus_0–Bus_1 [L0] at 114.7%** loading. The optimizer found five corrective options; **each was confirmed by an AC power-flow check** with no remaining violations.

| Option | Units instructed | MW moved | External-grid import | Cost (€/h) | Maximum loading |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Cheapest** | Gen_bus1, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10: P+V; Gen_bus12: V | 34.36 | 147.81 MW | **26.48** | 90.0% |
| **Least disturbance** | All five generators: P+V | 30.70 | 151.56 MW | 111.99 | 90.0% |
| **Fewest units** | Gen_bus1, Gen_bus4, Gen_bus7: P+V | 29.97 | 152.44 MW | 139.17 | 90.0% |
| **Most headroom** | All five generators: P+V | 51.00 | 130.14 MW | 575.32 | **68.3%** |
| **Least import** | All five generators: P+V | 99.82 | **78.26 MW** | 590.59 | 78.1% |

“P+V” means changing active-power output and voltage set-point; “V” means changing the set-point only. The cheapest option is **€85.51/h less than least disturbance**. Its cost is an estimate from the configured cost table; the reported prices draw on both synthetic and case-file values. The cost bound says no qualifying dispatch costs below **€22.48/h**, though a cheaper dispatch may still exist.

These are alternatives, not a selection—the preferred trade-off depends on your operating priorities.  
📋 Data source: measurements.

assistant:
I reran the options for **20:00 on 6 January** with **Gen_bus1 held at its scheduled active power**. All five options clear the Bus_29 undervoltage and Bus_0–Bus_1 [L0] overload in the AC power-flow check.

| Option | Other units instructed | MW moved | Grid import | Cost (€/h) | Max line loading |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Cheapest** | Gen_bus4, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10, Gen_bus12: P+V | 46.15 | 135.34 MW | **127.07** | 90.0% |
| Least disturbance | Gen_bus4: P; Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10, Gen_bus12: P+V | 44.01 | 137.20 MW | 163.66 | 90.0% |
| Fewest units | Gen_bus4, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10: P+V | 42.92 | 138.12 MW | 161.04 | 90.0% |
| Least import | Gen_bus4, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10, Gen_bus12: P+V | 65.78 | **113.77 MW** | 343.68 | 78.4% |
| Most headroom | Gen_bus4, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10, Gen_bus12: P+V | 65.89 | 113.84 MW | 435.18 | **78.0%** |

P+V means active-power output and voltage set-point changes; P means active-power output change. **Gen_bus1 receives no dispatch instruction**: its active output stays at 45.99 MW and its set-point at 1.025 p.u. Its reactive output can still respond under the model’s voltage control (for example, to 91.50 MVAr in the cheapest option); this is not a plan that takes the unit offline.

The cheapest option is **€36.59/h** below least disturbance. Costs use the configured mix of synthetic and case-file prices; they are estimates, not a choice on your behalf.

📋 Data source: measurements.
